2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a set-top box display__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __by retrieving authorization information specific to the subscriber__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __via a secure communication channel__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __wherein the channel identifier comprises a unique program identifier distinct from a PID__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the programs are delivered by one of a television network, a cable operator, a direct satellite program provider, a digital cable content provider, and a network content provider __wherein the content delivery provider operates independently from the EPG provider__.

7. (Currently Amended) An article of manufacture comprising: a machine-accessible medium including data that, when accessed by a machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving electronic program guide (EPG) information from an EPG provider __over a first communication link__; and filtering the EPG information to retain program information related to programs delivered by a content delivery provider to a subscriber __over a second communication link different from the first communication link__, the content delivery provider being different from the EPG provider.

8. (Currently Amended) The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a set-top box display__.

9. (Currently Amended) The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __by retrieving authorization information specific to the subscriber__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

10. (Currently Amended) The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __via a secure communication channel__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information.

11. 14. (Currently Amended) The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to display the filtered EPG information __on a set-top box display__.
